svg.title: Step-level credit: run R3 aligned to the reference trajectory
svg.desc: Run R3 (search, open, search, answer) is aligned against the reference trajectory (search, open, convert, answer) with the longest common subsequence. Three cells lie on the true diagonal of the 4 by 4 grid and are labelled MATCH in emerald: search-to-search, open-to-open, and answer-to-answer. R3's third step, a second search, matches nothing in the reference; its row header is boxed in amber and labelled EXTRA. The reference's convert step is covered by no candidate step; its column header is boxed in rose and labelled MISSING. Step counts: correct = 3, missing = 1, extra = 1. Credit = correct divided by (correct plus missing plus extra) = 3 divided by (3 plus 1 plus 1) = 0.60. For contrast, R3's order-aware score, the longest common subsequence length divided by the reference length, is 3 divided by 4 = 0.75. Credit is stricter than order-aware because it also charges the run for the extra step.
